reference.$description: Raw unitless effect values. Consumers use semantic effect roles rather than these primitives.

material.$description: Unitless material rendering ingredients. These tune the backdrop and do not stand in for semantic foreground vibrancy.

reduced.$description: No backdrop chroma amplification when transparency or contrast preferences request a quieter surface.

standard.$description: Gentle backdrop chroma recovery after blur softens the content beneath a material.

enhanced.$description: Explicitly stronger backdrop chroma for decorative material contexts with verified contrast.
